title: Blog Writer
description: Plan and write SEO blog posts with Claude using this project's real keyword, Search Console and site data, then copy paste-ready HTML.

start.title: Start a new post in Claude
start.description: Open Claude (connected to MericSEO) and paste this message. Claude picks the keyword with you from real data, analyses the top results, suggests titles and internal links, then writes the post and saves it here.
start.prompt: Let's write a new blog post for the MericSEO project "{{project}}" (project ID: {{projectId}}). Start with start_blog_post and go step by step.

list.title: Drafts
list.emptyDescription: Posts Claude writes for this project appear here.

detail.htmlHint: Paste into your CMS's HTML editor (Shopify: Show HTML). Includes the FAQ section and its FAQ schema. If your editor strips the schema script, use "Copy body only" and add the schema to the theme instead.
detail.revisePrompt: Let's revise the blog draft "{{title}}" in MericSEO project {{projectId}} (draft ID: {{draftId}}). Read it with get_blog_draft first. Changes I want:
detail.publishDescription: Enter the live post's URL. The post moves to Blog Tracking with its target keyword so you can follow its clicks and ranking.
detail.published: Published and added to Blog Tracking
detail.deleteDescription: This can't be undone. Posts already added to Blog Tracking stay there.
